checks.name: parallel browser commands share one attempt and one leased provider request
lost POST response reuses the same key/body and never creates a second provider object
callback body cannot declare success; authenticated provider state settles once
a correctly signed simulation event cannot settle a YooKassa attempt
cancel during a slow provider request is not blocked by a DB transaction; late success goes to review
callback recovers an unknown provider ID after expiry without a new POST
confirmed preorder is not debited again when YooKassa succeeds
unknown callbacks and foreign sessions cannot read or mutate another payment
mismatched verified amount is rejected without stock debit
payment snapshot fields cannot be rewritten and no new POST is sent after the idempotence window
a delayed pending response cannot regress a payment settled by a recovered lease
